observations: Predicted Active for daily 60 W×2 h versus idle 3 W×22 h over five days.
Tests gave 0.6 versus 0.33 kWh; maximum 30 days gave 3.6 versus 1.98.
Screenshot showed common-scale line slopes, with active endpoint touching upper stage edge. Reveal preserved original/current values and stated idle remains lower only under supplied numbers.
whyCool: A tiny idle draw adds up, but duration alone cannot tell you which load uses more.
caveat: Fixed illustrative schedule prevents exploring a crossover; top graph endpoint touches stage edge at maximum.
effort: Prediction, both tests, maximum days, screenshot and reveal.
